notes.title: 2019 UPDATES!
notes.notes:
[b][/b][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33333909/c761a8f281717aa63b576ea7e0a9cb6d304fd5e7.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

Good news! [b]Inevitable VR[/b] is under development once again. 

The game's code is being re-written, since the last update of SteamVR doesn't not support VRTK plug-in anymore (I am glad the game still work on Steam), which it helped me to quickly complete the game in no time on time. 

I am using the Unity Engine version 2018.3.2f1 rendered with the High Definition Pipeline system, plus I will be using the SteamVR plug-in. 
It does work well, and visually is great so far, which it is going to help me achieve a better graphic quality of the previous version.

In addition to re-writing, fixing all the gameplay mechanics, bugs and animations; I will also working on the second level of the game which I had just a prototype with basic mechanics.

Thank you all,

Davide Riccitiello

notes.title: Inevitable VR available on Store
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 - First Announcement

Since I am an Indie developer I need your assistance to make this game better.
I will be most of the time available, just send a message through the game Facebook Page, or email: davide.riccitiello@gmail.com to report bugs or ideas which you think could make the game more interesting.  

Another level of the game was supposed to come out with this release, but unfortunately had to be post-poned. 

After the 1st of September the game will change its status to Early Access.

Happy VR guys!

Your developer,

Davide
